question: 按分支和客户等级统计 2015 年交易额，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dc.Tier AS tier, db.Branch AS branch, SUM(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2015 GROUP BY dc.Tier, db.Branch ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 交易额以货币金额度量
Tier 是客户的分层属性
